title: POST /device-work/extraction/claim body (lld.md#text-extraction-and-ocr)
description: What this phone can do now. `pdfText` means it reads the text layer of a PDF (API 35 and later); `ocr` means the bundled Latin recognizer is ready. A phone that reports neither is told `no_capability`. The Worker decides per email whether recognition is allowed and says so in `ocrAllowed`.
